headline: Congress kicks off the week with minimal action as both chambers meet only briefly in pro forma session.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate convened at 10:00 a.m. in pro forma session and adjourned at 10:00 a.m., lasting just 33 seconds. No votes or business was conducted. The chamber will reconvene Thursday morning.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met briefly at 11:00 a.m. and adjourned at 11:02 a.m. Twelve public bills and three resolutions were introduced, but no votes were taken. Several Senate bills were received and held at the desk.
